headline.zh: 手冲豆单聚焦精品庄园

traits.zh: 主打哥斯达黎加巨石庄园、巴拿马安波里奥庄园手冲豆
traits.en: Features hand-drip coffees from Costa Rica's Piedra Grande and Panama's Amborio estates

traits.zh: 室内设阶梯式座位，室外有绿色桌椅与遮阳伞
traits.en: Indoor tiered seating and outdoor green tables with white umbrellas

traits.zh: 整面临街落地玻璃，可边喝咖啡边看窗外风景
traits.en: Full-height street-facing glass windows for viewing outside while drinking coffee

traits.zh: 供应明太子年轮唱片面包，顶上芝士缓流
traits.en: Serves mentaiko 'record' roll cake with slow-dripping cheese topping

traits.zh: 室外区域种植多种绿植
traits.en: Outdoor area planted with multiple types of greenery

focus.zh: 有阶梯式座位但无证据支持办公适配
focus.en: Tiered seating present, no evidence of work setup

linger.zh: 室内外多座位+绿植+观景，适合久坐
linger.en: Multiple indoor/outdoor seats, greenery, and views support lingering

adventure.zh: 专注两款高辨识度精品庄园手冲
adventure.en: Focused on two distinct, named specialty estate hand-drips
